text: Grab had **12,012 full-time employees** as of December 31, 2025, broken down as follows: General and administrative – 1,375; Sales and marketing – 785; Operations, support and supermarket retail – 6,888; Research and development – 2,964. This total includes 865 employees from Everrise (a Malaysian supermarket chain acquired in March 2025) and 22 employees from Infermove (an AI robotics startup acquired in December 2025). In addition, Grab had 1,242 fixed-term contract employees and 3,956 temporary agency workers as of that date [Grab, FY2025, p.117].
